READ THE LAUREATE

The brain, seen through human stories

Projections: A Story of Human Emotions · Karl Deisseroth

Clinical stories and neuroscience meet in a humane account of how brain circuits shape emotion—and how mental illness can reveal the architecture of ordinary inner life.

01

Two ways of knowing

Links the psychiatrist’s close attention to a person with the scientist’s study of cells and circuits.

02

Breakdown reveals design

Uses disorders of hunger, mood and social connection to illuminate how emotions are built.

03

Meaning stays human

Shows why biological explanation and empathy are partners, not competing accounts of a life.

Publisher book page ↗

WHY IT MATTERS

A switch for selected cells

Microbial opsins can be genetically placed in defined neurons. Carefully timed light then activates or inhibits those cells, letting researchers test causal links between circuit activity and behavior.

Verified source ↗
INPUTOpsin expression + wavelength + pulse
PROCESSPhoton-gated ion flow changes membrane potential
OUTPUTCell activity and downstream circuit behavior
